title: Gwangjang Market - Voices and Ajumma Greetings by kasparbossers

sourceDescription: Ambient recording from the food area of Gwangjang Market (광장시장), Seoul. Indistinct crowd voices and fragments of conversation throughout. Clattering of cooking and serving implements. Market vendors (ajumma) audible greeting customers.
